about.heading: About me
about.body: I’m Arun, a PGP student at IIM Kozhikode who started as an engineer and now works on the question behind the code: what’s worth building, and for whom? I studied CSE at BMSCE, worked as an SE II, and interned at Samsung R&D and Fidelity Investments. At Wipro Consulting, I evaluated ~220 small language models for a single use case and wrote a 0-to-1 BRD. Alongside my studies, I build agentic AI systems and take on case competitions, and I was a National Semi-Finalist at the Tata Imagination Challenge 2025 and at The Ken Case Competition (top 7% among 6,000+ teams). Engineer by training, strategist by habit, and I care about outcomes, not output.

projects.title: AI model due diligence
projects.summary: Picked the best-fit AI model for a client on cost, risk and value.
projects.details: During my Wipro Consulting internship I owned the evaluation that took a field of ~220 small language models down to the one that actually fit the client's constraints. I built a scoring rubric across capability, latency, cost, and safety, ran structured comparisons, and designed a guardrails layer to keep outputs on-policy. The real lesson: picking a model is a product decision in disguise — the 'best' benchmark score loses to the model that fits the user, the budget, and the risk tolerance. The work unlocked 93% projected cost savings for the client.

projects.title: Audience Brand Match
projects.summary: Brand-to-ad match tool for TV ad sales, from blank page to BRD.
projects.details: A greenfield concept to match audiences with the right brands. I led discovery, framed the core problem and target users, and translated it into a complete Business Requirements Document — scope, user stories, success metrics, and a prioritized path to a first version. It sharpened how I cut a fuzzy idea into something a team can actually build. Sized at USD 10 mn+ revenue upside and 20% faster pitch prep for ad sales teams.
